description: This file contains the implementation of a trait named RequiredParameterTrait that provides methods to check for the presence of required parameters within an array, used in the context of OAuth2 client functionalities. It is part of the league/oauth2-client library and supports parameter validation in OAuth2-related classes.

methods.name: checkRequiredParameter
methods.description: Checks for a required parameter in an array and throws an exception if missing.

methods.name: checkRequiredParameters
methods.description: Checks for multiple required parameters in an array by invoking checkRequiredParameter for each.
